title: USGS Notice — Gauge 2 Maintenance, 09:00–13:00

fields.fromName: USGS Iowa Water Science Center (Hydrologic Data Section)
fields.subject: Scheduled maintenance – upstream Cedar River index gauge (Gauge 2)
fields.body:
Good morning,

This is a courtesy notice to partners who use our real-time data on the Cedar River.

A USGS field crew will replace the stilling-well orifice line at Gauge 2, about 30 river miles upstream of Cedar Ford, between 09:00 and 13:00 CDT today, Tuesday, April 20. During the work, real-time stage and discharge from Gauge 2 may show gaps or be flagged provisional. Missing values during this period are an equipment outage, not a reading. Data will be reviewed and backfilled where possible once the new line is checked against the reference gauge.

This work does not affect the Cedar River at Cedar Ford gauge (CFDI4) on the Route 38 bridge piers, which will keep reporting as normal.

Routine notice. No action required.

Thank you,
fields.signature:
Hydrologic Data Section
USGS Iowa Water Science Center
Field Operations Desk | 319-555-0147

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The Coordinator should log the notice and set it aside, because CFDI4 is not affected. Watch whether they tell the duty desk that gaps in the Gauge 2 data are missing data, not a falling river, and that decisions still rest on the latest River Forecast Center issuance.
